frd.title: Fraud & RTO
frd.sub: What the risk steps caught, what turned out wrong, and what refused parcels cost you, in taka.

period.showing: Orders placed, and parcels that came back, from {from} to {to}.
period.bad: The end date was before the start date, so the last {days} days are shown.

kpi.wrongFoot: {rate} of the caught orders that reached the door
kpi.wrongNone: No caught order reached the door yet
kpi.missedFoot: Refused at the door with no risk step on them
kpi.savedFoot: Up to {upTo}. An estimate, not money that moved
kpi.savedUpOnly: At most this much. An estimate, not money that moved
kpi.savedNoCost: Enter the RTO costs to see this estimate
kpi.savedNone: No order was stopped in this period

caught.d: Orders placed in the period, by the step that caught them, and what became of each. An order two steps caught counts in both rows and once in “Any step”.

frd.advancePaid: {n} of them paid the advance that was asked.
frd.caughtNote: “Stopped” means cancelled before the courier had it, for a risk reason: declined after review, a duplicate, the advance not paid, or the number's owner never ordered. A customer's own cancel is not counted.

rto.d: Real parcels that came back in the period: the courier's charge out and back, plus your packaging, handling and (if you count it) ad share. Practice parcels never count.
rto.floor: {n} parcels miss a cost you have not entered yet ({parts}), so the real figure is higher than this.
rto.empty: No real parcel came back in this period.
rto.productNote: A parcel with several products counts under each, its cost split evenly, so the product rows still add up to the total.

frd.estimateNote: The saved cost is an estimate: the stopped orders times the average real cost of a returned parcel in this period (only parcels whose cost is complete), times the share of caught orders that were refused once they reached the door. “Up to” assumes every stopped order would have come back.

cut.orders: More than {n} caught orders in this period: the figures cover the newest {n}. Pick a shorter period, or raise the limit below.
cut.parcels: More than {n} returned parcels in this period: the cost book covers the newest {n}. Pick a shorter period, or raise the limit below.

card.d: How many days the report shows when no dates are picked, and the most orders and parcels one report reads.
card.maxRows: Most orders and parcels one report reads
card.maxRowsHelp: 100 to 20,000 (default: 5,000). Past it the page says the figures are cut short.

frd.readOnly: Only someone who may change settings can change this.

err.STALE: Someone else changed these settings in the meantime. The card shows theirs now; change it again if you need to.
err.FORBIDDEN: You may not change these settings.
err.forbidden: You may not change these settings.
err.network: No connection. Nothing was saved; try again.
err.other: Something went wrong. Nothing was saved; try again.
